name: guytrash

attributes.attribute: A form of the Skriker in British folklore.
It appeared just before a death.
It took the shape of a shaggy dog or a cow.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The guytrash was a British folkloric being tied to ill omens. This evil being formed part of the order of the Skriker and appeared shortly before a death. In its shape it took the form of a shaggy dog or a cow.

okr.objective: Define guytrash as an evil omen-bearing being in the Skriker order.
